jobs.title: Executive Director, IT Operations
jobs.description:
Category: District Leadership

Job Function: Administration

Department: IT Operations

**Summary**
-----------

The Executive Director of Information and Technology Operations provides leadership and strategic oversight for the District's enterprise technology systems, security, and operational services. This role ensures resilient, efficient, and secure IT operations including data centers, network services, systems administration, application development and management, and cloud services. The incumbent collaborates closely with senior district leadership to align technology strategies with educational and operational goals.

**Essential Duties**
--------------------

* Serves as a member of the IT Leadership team, contributing to the division’s strategy, vision, planning, service delivery, and overall direction
* Oversees district-wide IT operations, including data center management, systems and database administration, infrastructure operations, application development and management, business systems management, integration, cloud services, and IT Security
* Develops and implements enterprise technology standards, governance processes, and performance metrics to ensure high-quality IT operations
* Leads strategic technology initiatives and programs, ensuring alignment with district goals and priorities
* Provides technical expertise and strategic counsel to the Deputy CSTO and senior district leaders
* Drives continuous improvement in infrastructure efficiency, security, and cost-effectiveness
* Collaborates in developing and maintaining district IT security policies, procedures, and compliance protocols (FERPA, COPPA, CIPA etc.)
* Formulates and implements IT standards and procedures, overseeing adherence across the district
* Manages financial aspects of IT operations, including budget preparation, monitoring expenditures, and cost optimization
* Ensures robust disaster recovery and business continuity planning and testing
* Provides accurate and timely reporting to support informed decision-making at all levels of district leadership
* Conducts annual performance appraisals and facilitate professional growth opportunities for assigned staff
* Acts as a primary liaison for district technology initiatives, promoting collaboration among schools, district offices, external agencies, and community partners
* Maintains effective relationships across internal and external stakeholders, enhancing district-wide understanding and support of technology initiatives
* Monitors industry trends and emerging technologies, integrating relevant innovations to enhance district operations
* Adheres strictly to district, state, and federal laws and policies
* Performs other duties as assigned by the Deputy CSTO or appropriate administrator

**Required Education**
----------------------

Bachelor’s Degree in Information Technology Computers Science, Management Information Systems, or other field with a combination of relevant experience in Management Information Systems, Computer Science or A closely related field

Master's Degree preferred

**Certification/Licensure**
---------------------------

None required

CISSP, CISM, PMP, ITIL, CCNP, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, AWS Solutions Architect, Security+, VMWARE and/or other relevant industry certifications preferred

**Experience Qualifications**
-----------------------------

Minimum 8 years of progressively responsible experience in IT operations, including at least five (5) years in a leadership or supervisory role. Demonstrated success managing enterprise IT operations in educational organizations preferred

**Knowledge/Skills/Abilities**
------------------------------

* Comprehensive knowledge of current IT trends, best practices, and advanced technologies
* Expertise in infrastructure management, cybersecurity principles, systems administration, and network operations
* Demonstrated capability in managing complex projects, resources, and vendor relationships
* Proven strategic planning and budgeting skills with a track record of optimizing resources and enhancing operational effectiveness
* Exceptional leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills to effectively engage with diverse stakeholders

**Working Conditions**
----------------------

* Normal office environment

**Physical Demands**
--------------------

* Routine physical activity associated with normal office environment

Posting ID: 35315

It is the policy of the Fulton County School System not to discriminate on the basis of race, color, sex, religion, national origin, age, or disability in any employment practice, educational program, or any other program, activity, or service. jobs.description:
Overview:

**Job Title: Chief Information Officer / Program Lead**

**Location: Cherry Point, North Carolina**

Rivet Operations Company is looking for a Chief Information Officer (CIO)/ Program Lead to serve as the principal technical advisor and program lead at Marine Corps Air Station Cherry Point, North Carolina. This role sets and executes the IT strategy that keeps USMC aviation logistics systems secure, modern, and mission-ready, and advises leadership on emerging technologies such as AI and cloud to enhance readiness.

The CIO is responsible for the overall technical vision for ALD systems and for the accuracy of all contractor data input by program personnel. This role oversees software development, IT infrastructure, and engineering staff; manages IT resources and budgets; directs the modernization, upgrade, and lifecycle support of IT infrastructure; and ensures data security, privacy, and compliance with Department of Navy cybersecurity standards.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and oversee IT strategies that support 2nd MAW ALD goals, advise leadership on emerging technologies (AI, cloud, etc.) to enhance readiness, and manage the technical vision for ALD systems.

• Oversee software development, IT infrastructure, and engineering team members. • Support management of IT resources and budgets.

* Communicate with vendors.
* Assist in developing digital presentations and documentation.
* Oversee the modernization, upgrade, repair, and lifecycle support of IT infrastructure.
* Ensure data security, privacy, and compliance with Department of Navy (DON) cybersecurity standards, including conducting site visits to ensure cyber hygiene.
* Provide site-level configuration management support for aviation programs of record (e.g., NALCOMIS, ALIS/ODIN), and manage and troubleshoot server operating. systems (e.g., RHEL), including technical training and support for aviation IT systems and communication equipment.

Requirements:

**Required Qualifications**

* U.S. citizenship and ability to maintain a Secret security clearance.
* Master's degree in field of related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and experience. In lieu of a degree, candidates may qualify with an additional number of years of relevant experience.
* Experience to meet one of these qualifications is desired:
* 7 years’ specific experience with an associates degree
* 6 years’ general experience with a master’s degree.
* 3 years’ specific experience with a master’s degree.
* Specialized experience that includes understanding of USMC aviation information systems deployment doctrine, Navy program-of-record information systems and applications.
* Experience overseeing technology infrastructure, driving digital innovation, managing IT budgets, ensuring cybersecurity compliance, and leading IT personnel to improve operational efficiency.
* Experience planning and executing projects to ensure timely completion in accordance with established scope.
* Experience assisting in defining project goals, managing resources and teams, mitigating risk, and communicating updates to stakeholders.
* Experience ensuring quality control and leading cross-functional teams from project initiation through deployment.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

**Benefits:**

Rivet offers a comprehensive benefits package including a liberal vacation plan, a matching retirement program, and competitive salaries commensurate with skills and experience. For more information about our organization, please visit our web site at www.rivetopsllc.com.

**Physical Requirements:**

Work may involve sitting or standing for extended periods of time. Position may require typing and reading from a computer screen. Must have sufficient mobility, including but not limited to bending, reaching, and kneeling to complete daily duties in a timely and efficient manner. There is a possibility that due to parking availability and location of work, walking moderate to long distance may be required. Possible lifting up to 40 lbs.

Please note: Rivet Operations Company LLC reserves the right to change or modify job duties and assignments at any time. The above job description is not all encompassing. Positions functions and qualifications may vary depending on business needs.

Rivet Operations Company LLC is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate against applicants based on race, color, creed, religion, medical condition, legally protected genetic information, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth or related medical condition), sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, age, disability, or Vietnam era, or other eligible veteran status or legally protected characteristics.

jobs.description:
**Drive Technology Innovation and Build High-Performing Teams at Liberty Dental Plan**
======================================================================================

Are you a strategic technology leader who excels at developing people, partnering with the business, and delivering enterprise applications that drive measurable results? Liberty Dental Plan is seeking a **Director, IT Applications** to lead a critical portfolio of business applications while fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.

Reporting to the **VP, Application Development**, this highly visible leadership role combines technology strategy, operational excellence, and people leadership. You will help shape the future of our application landscape, strengthen business partnerships, and guide a talented team responsible for delivering reliable, secure, and scalable solutions that support our members, clients, and organization.

**About the Role**
------------------

The Director, IT Applications is responsible for leading the delivery, support, maintenance, and ongoing evolution of enterprise applications across assigned business areas. This role ensures applications meet business needs, service level commitments, quality standards, and security requirements while supporting operational performance and organizational growth.

The ideal candidate brings a combination of healthcare payer industry knowledge, strong people leadership capabilities, business acumen, and experience managing vendor relationships and enterprise application portfolios.

**Location:** Remote

**Reporting Relationship:** VP, Application Development

**What You'll Do**
------------------

### **Technology Strategy & Application Leadership**

* Lead the delivery, support, maintenance, and optimization of critical business applications.
* Serve as the product owner for assigned application platforms, establishing strategic priorities, modernization initiatives, and technology roadmaps.
* Partner with business leaders to understand requirements, identify process bottlenecks, and recommend technology solutions that improve efficiency and productivity.
* Balance business priorities, operational stability, modernization efforts, and technical debt reduction.
* Guide application strategy and influence technical direction in partnership with technical teams and stakeholders.

### **Operational Excellence**

* Ensure applications meet agreed-upon service level expectations for availability, performance, incident response, and production support.
* Oversee release planning, production readiness, ongoing maintenance, and enhancement activities.
* Maintain strong controls around data integrity, compliance, security, and system management.
* Monitor application health, technical debt, and remediation efforts while communicating risks and progress to leadership.
* Identify and proactively address operational and delivery risks to ensure successful outcomes.
* Support audits, client reviews, regulatory inquiries, proposal responses, and new client implementation activities.

### **Vendor & Stakeholder Management**

* Build and maintain strong relationships with vendors, business leaders, and cross-functional partners.
* Manage third-party resources and consulting relationships to support delivery and operational objectives.
* Partner with compliance, security, infrastructure, architecture, governance, and business operations teams to ensure alignment and execution.
* Navigate competing priorities effectively while maintaining strong stakeholder relationships and transparency.

### **People & Team Leadership**

* Lead, coach, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of technology professionals.
* Create an environment where employees feel supported, empowered, and accountable for results.
* Establish clear expectations and provide ongoing performance feedback and development opportunities.
* Foster collaboration, trust, continuous learning, and professional growth.
* Delegate effectively while developing future leaders and building organizational capability.
* Recognize and celebrate team contributions while maintaining a high-performance culture.

**What You'll Bring**
---------------------

### **Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, or a related field.
* 10+ years of experience in IT applications, application support, systems delivery, or a related discipline.
* 5+ years of people leadership experience.
* Strong understanding of application delivery, support, operations, and service level management.
* Experience with software development lifecycles, release management, production support, and application maintenance practices.
* Experience managing vendors, budgets, resources, operational risks, and delivery governance.
* Ability to build trusted relationships with business leaders, technical teams, and external partners.
* Strong communication, problem-solving, decision-making, and leadership skills.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Healthcare payer experience, including Medicare and/or Medicaid environments.
* Dental payer experience strongly preferred.
* Experience supporting delegated healthcare models and healthcare operations.
* Experience with **Health Solutions Plus (HSP)** and healthcare payer administration platforms highly preferred.

The Director of IT leads the organization’s technology strategy and operations for San Antonio and provides shared services, governance, and oversight for affiliates. This leader ensures secure, reliable, and scalable technology that advances the organization’s mission and enables high-performing teams. The role integrates enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, data governance, and vendor management, aligning technology investments to strategic outcomes, and ensuring consistent standards across the network.

**Job Responsibilities**

* Develop and execute a strategic IT roadmap aligned with organizational strategy and programmatic impact.
* Establish relationships to help build better workings across AVANCE San Antonio and subsidiaries to prioritize approve standards and manage risk on projects.
* Define and maintain enterprise IT policies (security, acceptable use, data retention, access, incident response, business continuity).
* Drive architecture standards for identity, devices, networks, data, and integrations across SAN ANTONIO and subsidiaries.
* Design, implement and maintain a uniform and common architecture for computer hardware, software, telecommunications, local area and wide networks for the entire agency. This includes continually identifying emerging information technologies to assimilate, integrate, and introduce within the agency.
* Develop and distribute policies and procedures that apply to hardware, software, and telecommunications systems and their use by AVANCE staff and other authorized individuals.
* Develop, review and certify all back-up and disaster recovery procedures and plans.
* Network administration (including backup, security management, user account management, e-mail systems including e-mail web servers, internet access, office systems and applications support).

* Lead RFPs, contract negotiations, and performance management of MSPs, SaaS, and telecom providers.

jobs.title: Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) – BCG Federal
jobs.description:
**Locations**: Washington | Boston

Who We Are

Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

What You'll Do

The Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) serves as the primary executive authority on enterprise cybersecurity strategy, risk governance, and federal compliance for BCG Federal. Reporting regularly to the Government Security Committee (GSC) and executive leadership, the CISO holds direct authority to define and approve the federal IT security boundary, manage enterprise risk, and escalate unresolved security exposures. Operating as an executive peer alongside business and technology leaders, the CISO balances client mission enablement with rigorous defense compliance mandates.

The CISO leads a dedicated cyber organization of approximately 25 professionals and directs the strategic security interface between BCG Federal and BCG Global IT and Security. In this capacity, the CISO ensures our streamlined cloud environment—primarily Microsoft 365 GCC-High, Azure Government, and AWS DevOps pipelines—remains properly isolated and compliant with Defense Counterintelligence and Security Agency (DCSA) standards, while safely leveraging global shared capabilities where permitted.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Executive Governance & GSC Advisory:** Define enterprise security strategy, deliver regular security and compliance briefings to the Government Security Committee (GSC), and maintain risk governance aligned with federal missions and strategic corporate growth.
* **Team Leadership & Cyber Operations:** Direct a ~15-person cybersecurity organization across core functions, including security operations, compliance, cloud security architecture, IAM, and vulnerability management.
* **Global Parent Alignment & Boundary Integrity:** Partner with BCG Global CISO and IT leadership to maintain boundary isolation, data barriers, and access controls separating BCG Federal enclaves from commercial global infrastructure.
* **Cloud Architecture & Enclave Protection:** Oversee the security architecture and boundary controls for a focused cloud environment centered on Microsoft 365 GCC-High, Azure Government, and AWS DevOps pipelines, ensuring strict protection of Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) and export-controlled data.
* **Federal Compliance & Audit Ownership:** Own enterprise compliance for NIST SP 800-171, NIST SP 800-53, DFARS 252.204-7012, and CMMC Level 2, leading System Security Plan (SSP) maintenance, SPRS scoring, and C3PAO/federal audit readiness.
* **Technology Controls Administration:** Collaborate with Legal, the Facility Security Officer (FSO), and leadership to administer the Technology Control Plan (TCP) and ensure systems adhere to DCSA security requirements and governance obligations.
* **Business Development & Mission Enablement:** Partner with capture and client delivery teams to architect compliant, secure solutions for client enclaves and support proposal responses.
* **AI Security Governance:** Provide security and compliance oversight for vetting, deploying, and governing AI tools, LLMs, and emerging technologies within CUI-constrained environments.
* **Supply Chain & Third-Party Risk (SCRM):** Oversee vendor risk assessments, software supply chain security, and FedRAMP cloud service provider evaluations across subcontractors and external integrations.

What You'll Bring

* Experience: 7–10+ years of IT security and information assurance experience, including 2–4+ years operating within the Defense Industrial Base (DIB) or a directly comparable national security environment.
* People Leadership: 7+ years of demonstrated success directly managing multi-disciplinary IT teams, setting operational rhythms, and mentoring technical leads.
* Cloud & Infrastructure Mastery: Strong architectural knowledge of Microsoft GCC-High / Azure Government (Entra ID, Purview, Defender, Intune) and foundational AWS DevOps/IAM security baselines.
* Regulatory Expertise: In-depth understanding of NIST SP 800-171, DFARS 7012, CMMC Level 2, and DCSA oversight requirements.
* Clearance: Active Top Secret clearance required
* Education & Certifications: Bachelor’s degree in a relevant technical or government/business discipline. Recent coursework in AI and Cybersecurity a plus.

Additional info

At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.

For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.

We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork.

\*\*\* For US locations only \*\*\*

In the US, we have a compensation transparency approach.

Total compensation for this role includes base salary, annual discretionary performance bonus, retirement contribution, and a market leading benefits package described below.

  

* The base salary range for this role begins at $225,000 in ou

jobs.title: Head of IT & Security
jobs.description:
**Head of IT & Security**

**About us:**  
At Fullbay, our mission is simple — to create safer roads for our families and yours. As leaders in the heavy-duty repair industry, we power shops with technology that helps them run smarter and more efficiently. As an AI-First company, we invite artificial intelligence to eliminate friction, spark innovation, and drive efficiencies in every conversation— for our teams and our customers. Fullbay is the number one cloud-based shop management software for commercial repair shops and is growing fast. This is an exciting opportunity to join a high-performing team and help shape the next phase of growth for the company.

  

**Position Overview:**

Fullbay's Security and IT Manager owns two functions that are usually split across two people: the security program that keeps Fullbay's systems, people, and customer data safe, and the IT operations that keep the business running day to day. Reporting to the VP of IT, this role designs the security and IT program from the ground up and owns its execution end-to-end — there's no existing playbook to inherit and no separate team to hand the work to.

This role is well-suited to someone who has built a security program before, not just operated inside one — someone comfortable being the primary responder when an MDR alert escalates, the person who leads SOC 2 through an actual audit, and the same person who's also the company's escalation point when someone's laptop won't image. This is a player-coach role: you set the standards, and you personally execute the work.

Success here looks like passing SOC 2 audits with no major findings, on schedule; security incidents that get triaged, contained, and resolved fast enough that they stay incidents, not breaches; IT support that doesn't make employees wait, with devices provisioned before day one and tickets closed without a saga; and a risk posture leadership can see clearly at any time, not just when an audit forces the question.

**The Right Wrench for the Job**

A shop's most dangerous moments are never the ones people see coming. The person who wires the electrical panel, checks the fire suppression, and makes sure the alarm actually calls someone when it goes off isn't thinking about any one repair — they're thinking about what keeps the whole building standing. This role does that for Fullbay's systems and data, and then still picks up the phone when someone's laptop won't turn on.

You're the right fit if you've built a security program from a blank page before — not just operated inside one someone else designed — and you know the difference between a control that looks good on paper and one that actually holds up when an auditor or an attacker tests it. You can walk into a SOC 2 evidence review in the morning, triage a real MDR alert at noon, and still be the person who gets a new hire's laptop imaged and ready before their first day.

This isn't the role for someone who wants to own strategy and hand off the keyboard. If your instinct is to write the policy and let someone else enforce it, this isn't your shop. But if you're the kind of person who'll design the program, defend it to an auditor, and still crawl under the desk to fix a network cable — we'd like to talk.

**Primary Duties & Responsibilities:**

* Security Program Ownership: Design, build, and continuously improve Fullbay’s security program using NIST CSF 2.0 as the governance architecture and CIS Controls v8.1 (IG1 to IG2) as the tactical execution roadmap.
* Security Operations Oversight: Manage Fullbay’s always-on MDR platform, which provides automated threat detection and triage across endpoints and cloud environments. Serve as the primary responder for escalated alerts requiring human judgment, and lead investigation, containment, and remediation for confirmed incidents, including participation in an on-call rotation for high-severity escalations.
* SOC 2 Readiness and Audit Management: Lead all SOC 2 readiness activities including control mapping, evidence collection, gap remediation, and audit firm coordination for Type I and Type II engagements.
* Tool and Platform Governance: Own and configure Fullbay’s security tooling stack, including the MDR platform, MDM, email security, anti-phishing, and security awareness training. Tune and maintain tools to Fullbay standards, and evaluate new tools or vendors as needed.
* Policy and Standards Development: Author, maintain, and enforce information security policies, standards, and procedures across the organization. Ensure policies align with regulatory requirements and audit frameworks.
* Identity and Access Management: Oversee IAM posture across Google Workspace, including passkeys, MFA, SSO, and privileged access controls, including MDM and Apple Business Manager configuration.
* Incident Response: Develop and own the incident response plan. Serve as the primary responder for security events escalated by the MDR platform or identified through other internal monitoring. Lead response activities and post-incident reviews.
* Risk Management: Maintain a risk register. Identify, assess, and track security risks across people, process, and technology. Communicate risk posture to the VP of IT and senior leadership.
* Security Awareness: Oversee the security awareness training program, including phishing simulations and compliance-based training cycles.
* Vendor and Third-Party Risk: Assess security posture of third-party vendors and new software applications. Maintain a vendor risk inventory and drive remediation for identified gaps.

jobs.title: Field Chief Technology Officer (CTO)
jobs.description:
**Field Chief Technology Officer (CTO)**
========================================

*US-Remote*

Reports to: Chief Executive Officer

**Who We Are**
--------------

At 8th Light, we bring life to the best ideas.

Founded in 2006 and headquartered in Chicago, we are a technology solutions provider that partners with organizations to solve meaningful challenges and drive sustainable growth. From early-stage startups to global enterprises, we work across industries to optimize our clients’ digital products through product strategy innovation, experiential design, AI solutions, and deep engineering expertise.

Our commitment to quality means we deliver solutions we’re truly proud of, while our curiosity sparks innovation and breakthrough thinking. 8th Lights thrive in an environment that champions continuous education, fueling our growth through mentorship and hands-on work. We foster an open, collaborative culture grounded in honesty that builds trust, and believe true success is measured by the outcomes we create for our clients.

If this kind of work and our kind of people energizes you, you’ve found the right place.

**Who You Are**
---------------

You’ve spent 10+ years in custom software consultancies, and you’ve been a regular presence on both sides of the business: in the room helping win the work, and in delivery helping build it. You know how to pitch a client honestly and then stand behind what you promised.

You’re highly articulate and commercially fluent. You can talk architecture with a skeptical engineering lead in one meeting and talk ROI with a client’s CEO in the next, and both walk away trusting you. You understand how technical choices shape whether a project makes money because you’ve had to make those calls yourself.

Your technical judgment comes from years of hands-on work, and you keep it current in two ways: you read widely, and you keep doing the work. “Doing” might be a few hours each week staying sharp with new tools, or it might be real delivery responsibility on a live engagement. Either way, you don’t run on knowledge that stopped accruing years ago.

You’re comfortable leading by influence rather than authority. You may not be our deepest expert on any single topic, and that’s fine, because your value shows up differently:

* You ask experienced technologists the kind of sharp questions that send them back to their desk thinking.
* You know a good deal across a wide range of subjects and connect ideas others keep separate.
* You’re an excellent communicator, in writing and on your feet.
* You bring out people’s best work through interpersonal connection and high standards.

Your name carries some weight in the communities you’re part of. When you write or speak, senior engineers pay attention, and a few of them want to come work with you.

This is primarily a market-facing role. You’d rather be out in the market shaping where we go than waiting inside for an assignment.

**What You’ll Do At 8th Light**
-------------------------------

We win work by earning technical trust before a contract is ever signed, and by being genuinely present in the market the rest of the time. This role carries both. You’ll report to the CEO and work most closely with the CEO, the VP of Growth, our practice Partners, and senior technologists.

Your primary focus will require you to:

* Join deal teams to help win new engagements. In a pitch that can mean proposing an architecture, shaping scope, sequencing the work into sensible stages, or recommending how to staff it. On our most important accounts, you’ll stay a technical presence the client trusts well after the work begins.
* Represent us and build relationships in the market. Give talks, write, and show up in person at events. In-person presence matters here, and writing alone won’t carry the role.
* Shape and sharpen what we sell. Turn what you’re seeing in the market into clearer, more current offerings, and keep our position honest: agentic products, deep platform expertise.
* Work with our Growth team to help identify and build relationships with platform and AI partners that put us in front of the right work and keep our teams current.
* Drive our go-to-market direction rather than wait for it. Bring a point of view and help us continuously iterate on where we should show up, what we should say, and which opportunities are worth chasing.

Internally, your footprint is lighter but real. You’re the standard other technologists measure themselves against, and you’re a mentor to those working on their business leadership and impact. You’ll weigh in from time to time on technical job standards and career pathing. You’ll start without direct reports and lead through influence, and as we grow, the role could grow into leading a small team.

**Strongly Preferred Skills**
-----------------------------

We’d particularly like to hear from applicants with:

* A track record of pitching and winning enterprise engagements inside a consultancy
* A public technical presence: talks you’ve given, things you’ve written, communities you help lead
* Experience shaping the service offerings or the technical point of view a firm takes to market
* Relationships with cloud or AI platform partners, and the standing that comes with them
* A working grasp of where AI and agentic tooling is heading, enough to judge where the real opportunities are
* Experience mentoring senior technical talent and raising the bar around them

**Compensation**
----------------

Our pay range for the Field CTO role is $230,000–$287,500 USD, plus 20–30% variable compensation based on performance.

**Travel Expectation**
----------------------

This role involves regular but not frequent travel, mostly for in-person events, client pitches, and the occasional team gatherings.

**How You’ll Be Supported**
---------------------------

At 8th Light, our culture is built on the belief that our collective growth and well-being are the drivers of our future.

* Our wellness

**Overview**

The Senior Account 360 Program Manager is responsible for driving end-to-end alignment across Microsoft’s most complex commercial engagements. This role sits at the intersection of Commercial Sales, Cloud + AI Infrastructure (Co&I), Digital Win Room (DWR), Strategic Pursuit Team (SPT), Industry, Corporate, External and Legal Affairs (CELA) and Finance, ensuring that Microsoft’s sell-to and buy-from motions are strategically aligned to maximize deal outcomes.

You will act as the single point of orchestration across internal stakeholders, enabling “One Microsoft” execution by aligning incentives, surfacing trade-offs, and driving clarity across competing priorities to land favorable balance of trade outcomes in strategic deals.

Microsoft's mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Deal-Level Account 360 Strategy & Execution

* Partner with sales teams, DWR, and SPT on top strategic opportunities to define and execute Balance of Trade strategies

* Identify misalignment risks early (e.g., conflicting incentives, supplier exposure, capacity constraints) and drive resolution
* Support structuring of complex deals to optimize Microsoft’s overall position—not just individual opportunity outcomes

Cross-Org Orchestration (Co&I, Engineering, Procurement, DWR, SPT, Sales, Finance, Industry)

Executive Engagement & Decision Support

jobs.title: Director of Technology & AI Automation
jobs.description:
Position Summary

The Director of Technology & AI Automation oversees FEI's technology infrastructure and leads the identification, implementation, and adoption of AI and automation solutions across the institution. This role bridges traditional IT operations (systems, networks, data security) with practical AI deployment, including building and running the AI automation layer that supports enrollment marketing and student outreach. The Director ensures all technology is reliable, secure, and aligned with FEI's operational, marketing, and compliance requirements.

Duties & Responsibilities

Technology Operations

* Oversee day-to-day IT operations, including systems, networks, and data security.
* Ensure institutional data systems (SIS, CRM, LMS) are integrated and functioning reliably, including integrations needed for marketing AI tools.
* Develop and enforce data security and privacy practices, including for AI tool usage.
* Manage vendor relationships for IT infrastructure, SIS, and AI/automation platforms, and coordinate with vendors and technical support to resolve issues.
* Manage the technology budget, including AI tool licensing and infrastructure costs.
* Supervise IT and automation support staff or contractors.

AI Implementation

* Lead the planning and rollout of AI and automation initiatives across departments.
* Partner with department leaders (Marketing, Admissions, Financial Aid, Academics) to assess workflows and identify processes suited for automation.
* Research and recommend off-the-shelf or lightly customized AI solutions.
* Lead implementation projects from pilot through full deployment.
* Maintain an inventory of active AI tools and their institutional use cases.

Marketing & Enrollment Automation

* Build and manage AI agent workflows for inbound and outbound admissions and marketing outreach.
* Configure multilingual AI scheduling for admissions appointments and information sessions.
* Use AI tools to support social media content planning and website content creation.
* Deploy AI-driven surveys to gather student and prospect feedback.
* Work with the CMO to align AI automation efforts with enrollment marketing goals.
* Monitor AI agent performance and refine scripts, prompts, and workflows over time.

Training, Reporting & Compliance

* Develop training materials and lead onboarding sessions for staff using new AI tools.
* Measure and report on the impact of deployed AI solutions (efficiency, response time, conversion).
* Ensure technology, AI practices, and AI-generated content comply with applicable federal, state, and accreditor requirements and FEI brand standards.

Position Requirements

Education

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Marketing, or related field required; Master's preferred.

Experience

* 5+ years in IT management, technology operations, technology implementation, or marketing automation, including team or vendor oversight.
* Demonstrated experience rolling out software or AI tools to non-technical teams.
* Experience with AI agent, chatbot, or AI content tools strongly preferred.
* Higher education or regulated-industry experience a plus.

Technology

* Proficient with common workplace technology and software, including IT infrastructure management, SIS/CRM/LMS platforms, AI agent and chatbot platforms, marketing automation tools, content creation software, and project management software.
* Comfortable learning and using institutional systems related to admissions, financial aid, and student records.
* Adapts readily to new software and technology as institutional systems evolve.

Skills & Attributes

* Strong leadership, project management, and cross-departmental coordination skills.
* Strategic thinker able to balance innovation with operational stability.
* Strong writing and content sensibility for student-facing communication.
* Comfortable testing and iterating on AI prompts and scripts.
* Analytical mindset with the ability to translate results into plain-language reporting.
* Patient, effective trainer for staff at varying technical comfort levels.
* Sound judgment on data security and regulatory compliance.

Pay: $100,000.00 - $125,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Professional development assistance
* Retirement plan
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

**Title:** Director of TechnologyReports to: Head of SchoolThe Miami Valley School (MVS). Our mission is to challenge young people of promise to become self-sustaining learners and compassionate global citizens. For almost 60+ years, MVS has provided a unique learning option for families in the Dayton, Ohio, community. Here, faculty are educators who are ready to help refine a truly differentiated educational opportunity as MVS becomes a nationally-recognized leader in experience-based learning.
  
  
Here, every member of the MVS community is committed to transformative immersive learning in the classroom and during our Immersion term. Equally important is our commitment to Social Emotional Learning (SEL), through which our students learn the skills and competencies necessary to navigate an ever-shifting world with confidence and curiosity. Here, we learn because we do.The Role. MVS is seeking a knowledgeable, meticulous, and creative technology leader to serve as Director of Technology.
  
  
This pivotal role acts as the lead technology engineer, primary support technician, and strategic leadership liaison for the school's technology department. Directing all department operations, the Director oversees the design, provisioning, deployment, configuration, and maintenance of all campus technology resources. Key responsibilities include managing student and employee devices, internet and intranet routing, network security, account provisioning, printing systems, VoIP, and campus-wide WiFi. Deep expertise in Windows and Linux system administration is imperative, paired with an eager commitment to continuous learning.
  
  
As a customer service-oriented leader, this individual interacts daily with the entire school communityincluding students from early childhood through high school, faculty, staff, and familieshandling every interaction with high empathy, patience, and skill. The Opportunity. All members of MVS vibrant faculty bring the schools mission and vision to life each day for students and families in the Dayton community. Each day we live out our mission through our core values: integrity, celebration, grit, and kindness.
  
  
As a part of our dynamic team, you will have the opportunity to: Expand Global Leadership. MVS is known for its academic and extracurricular programming, and with you on our team, we will continue to grow with our students as leaders of Global Citizenship and stewards of civil discourse. Enhance Cultural Experiences. Through your multicultural lens and passion for experiences in which students can be empathetic, you will support faculty in creating awe-inspiring programs utilizing the MVS Immersion Method and cultivate a sense of courage in students to experience the world, explore passions, and dive deep into content.Develop Character and Wellness.
  
  
To support the overall wellness of our vibrant community, youll have the opportunity to meaningfully connect and collaborate with students and families.Innovate. As we continue to develop our Immersive Learning programming, you will be part of a team that is enhancing professional learning nationwide and becoming a thought leader for immersive learning experiences that stretch beyond the traditional school experience.Couple Academic Rigor with Increased Accessibility. Through your intentional support and empowerment, our students will explore their unique learning needs, utilize critical thinking, and begin to think about and create solutions for todays pressing challenges.Collaborate as part of a World-Class Team. In your role at MVS, you will work alongside dedicated faculty who have taught and learned all over the world and in a variety of school contexts.
  
  
Your colleagues are artists, researchers, entrepreneurs, published authors, professional musicians, armed services veterans, and thespians. Most importantly, they are compassionate and caring educators committed to lifelong learning.And of course, you will get to make an impact! As the Director of Technology, you will get to join young people on their journey through discovering their sense of self, building healthy relationships, and growing both personally and socially. You will have the privilege of being a supportive resource and guidepost for students, families, faculty, and staff.Expectations: Relational leadership: Build trusted, collaborative partnerships across administration, faculty, staff, parents, and students with a "listen-first" philosophy.Proactive communication: Deliver clear, transparent, and timely communication tailored to diverse audiences (prospective families, faculty, tech-novices, and leadership).Operational agility: Prioritize and execute complex, multi-stakeholder initiatives independently while meeting hard deadlines.Community investment: Engage visibly in campus life beyond core technical duties (e.g., advising, attendance at major school traditions).Availability mindset: Maintain flexibility for evening/weekend critical maintenance windows or crisis response.Primary Responsibilities: Strategic Vision & EdTech Integration: Partner with division heads and the leadership team to align technology roadmap with institutional strategic planning, modern pedagogy, and AI/digital literacy trends.Infrastructure & Cybersecurity Oversight: Oversee enterprise systems, network architecture, cloud services, and school-wide cybersecurity posture, student data privacy compliance, security and camera systems, and disaster recovery.Faculty/Staff Capacity & Professional Learning: Design and coordinate targeted pedagogical technology training, coaching faculty/staff to integrate digital tools meaningfully through direct, hands on instructional support.Leadership & Tier-3 Support: Guide technical operations (supported by internal staff/student tech cohorts where applicable), stepping in for high-impact tier-3 troubleshooting and user empowerment.Budget & Vendor Lifecycle: Manage hardware/software lifecycle planning, vendor relationship

jobs.title: Senior Finance Director, IT/Security and Core Functions (Hybrid Preferred, Remote Work Considered)
jobs.description:
**Job Description**  

Ready to make a difference? Our employees design, integrate, and test the world's next generation communication and electronic warfare systems for the United States DoW and international customers. Drawing strength from our differences, we're innovating for the future. We put our customers first - exemplified by our mission: "We Protect Those Who Protect Us." Sound like a team you want to be a part of? Come build your career with us.
  
  
We are seeking an experienced **Finance Director** to **support IT, Security and other Core Functions** (**Finance**, **HR**, **Contracts**, **Strategy**, etc.) and play a key role in driving sector-wide strategies that optimize performance, increase efficiency, and align with long-term business objectives. As a strategic Finance business partner, you will collaborate with key Functional leaders to develop and execute financial plans, drive transformational initiatives, and foster a culture of operational excellence.
  
  
This role is **preferred to be performed in a hybrid remote work format**, with the individual splitting their time between our office at 10 Tara Blvd, Nashua, NH, and remotely from an alternate work location. **For the right individual, a full-time remote format may be considered.**

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Strategic Finance Business Partner**: Serve as a trusted advisor to IT/Security and Core Functional leaders, providing financial guidance to optimize operational cost, throughput, and profitability.
* **Financial Strategy Execution**: Drive the development and execution of the financial strategy for IT/Security and Core Functions, including leading key transformational initiatives and ensuring effective resourcing.
* **Finance Transformation**: Lead efforts to enhance, automate, and analyze financial processes and systems to support IT/Security and Core Functions, driving improvements in efficiency and effectiveness.
* **Investment Decisions**: Support key investment decisions, including capital expenditures, footprint optimization, and make-buy analysis, providing financial insights and recommendations.
* **Collaboration and Stakeholder Management**: Coordinate with internal stakeholders and subject matter experts to build and sustain best practices and operational excellence in support of IT/Security and Core Functions.
* **Metrics, Reporting, and Communication**: Establish and maintain standard metrics, reporting, and communication to support IT/Security and Core Functional Finance, ensuring timely and accurate information for stakeholders.
* **Team Leadership**: Lead and direct a team of Finance professionals, inspiring a high-performing team that embodies BAE Systems' behaviors and cultural principles.

  
  
**Required Education, Experience, & Skills**  

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or related field.
* 10+ years of experience in finance, with a focus on operations or business partnering.
* Proven track record of driving transformational change and improving financial performance.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
* Ability to build and maintain effective relationships with stakeholders, including Operations leaders and subject matter experts

  
  
**Preferred Education, Experience, & Skills**  

* MBA or Master's in related field preferred
* Business analytics and systems expertise
* Strong project management skills

  
  
**Pay Information**
  
Full-Time Salary Range: $157911 - $268449
  
  
Please note: This range is based on our market pay structures. However, individual salaries are determined by a variety of factors including, but not limited to: business considerations, local market conditions, and internal equity, as well as candidate qualifications, such as skills, education, and experience.
  
  
Employee Benefits: At BAE Systems, we support our employees in all aspects of their life, including their health and financial well-being. Regular employees scheduled to work 20+ hours per week are offered: health, dental, and vision insurance; health savings accounts; a 401(k) savings plan; disability coverage; and life and accident insurance. We also have an employee assistance program, a legal plan, and other perks including discounts on things like home, auto, and pet insurance. Our leave programs include paid time off, paid holidays, as well as other types of leave, including paid parental, military, bereavement, and any applicable federal and state sick leave. Employees may participate in the company recognition program to receive monetary or non-monetary recognition awards. Other incentives may be available based on position level and/or job specifics.  
  
  
  
**About BAE Systems, Inc.**
  
BAE Systems, Inc. is a defense, aerospace, and security company headquartered in Falls Church, Virginia, with more than 40,000 employees worldwide. We serve, supply, and protect those who protect us. As one of the most geographically diverse international defense companies, we deliver a full range of products and services spanning air, land, maritime, space, and cyber, including advanced electronics, intelligence solutions, and dedicated customer support.
  
  
Our culture is performance-driven and values-led, built on curiosity, creativity, and collaboration. Purpose isn't a tagline here. It's what drives us. We're developing breakthrough technologies that defend national security and make a lasting impact on our communities and our planet. When you join BAE Systems, you're not just building a career. You're contributing to a mission that truly matters.
  
  
This position will be posted for at least 5 calendar days. The posting will remain active until the position is filled, or a qualified pool of candidates is identified.

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer (CTO)
jobs.description:
The role is compensated with restricted shares for the first 6 to 12 months.

Internet Sciences Inc ( ISI) is looking for a passionate and inspiring Chief Technology Officer to lead our tech organization as part of our executive leadership team. Reporting directly to the CEO, the Chief Technology Officer is a key leader that supports our global tech and product teams.

We’re looking for a leader who is excited by building a world-class engineering organization centered around excellence, iteration, and innovation.

You should be an effective communicator with the ability to inspire and motivate — in strong partnership with the head of the product organization you will create a collaborative and innovative culture that will support the growth and effectiveness of our tech organization. You believe in and can help nurture our values of curiosity, inclusiveness, and collaboration.

Job Types: Full-time, Part-time

Salary: $50,000.00 - $150,000.00 per year

Supplemental pay types:

* Bonus pay

* Master's (Required)

Work Location: Remote
